To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
17 QTLs were identified under drought stress in the field and 36 QQLs were identified under stress in PVC pipes in the two years.
the drought stress at the booting to heading stages of paddy rice affects the development of panicle exsert, plant height and flag leaf length, and causes significant grain yield loss.
the QTLs for four morphologic characters under drought stress were identified, and the application of these QTLs as indirect indices was discussed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of QTLs for rice late season drought stress resistance.
the genetic basis of rice morphologic traits under drought stress.
rice late season drought tolerance and provides useful information on the genetic basis of rice late season drought response.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the genetic basis of these morphologic traits in rice under drought stress is complicated and that the QTLs for the traits under stress conditions are different from those under non-stress condition.
the QTLs detected under different water conditions and their ratios or differences are useful for improving rice late-season drought resistance.
the genetic basis of these drought resistance morphologic traits was more complex than previously reported, and that these traits were controlled by multiple QTLs with different effects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
QTL mapping of rice late season drought tolerance is a promising strategy to identify the genes for improving rice drought resistance.
QTL analysis of rice morphologic traits under drought stress can be carried out in the field and in PVC pipes.

the drought resistance of rice can be improved by the combination of genetic engineering and conventional breeding, and the QTLs for rice drought resistance identified in this study will be helpful to the improvement of rice late season drought tolerance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the drought stress at different stages has a significant effect on the morphologic traits and the genetic basis of these morphologic traits under stress condition is different.
QTLs for morphologic traits are different between well water and drought conditions.

the drought stress at the stage of booting and panicle initiation is not the same in the field and in PVC pipes, and the genetic basis of the morphologic trait under drought stress is complex and dynamic, which should be considered when breeding rice for late season drought tolerance.
